slides.title: From AI Lessons to Verifiable AI Capability
slides.subtitle: The AI Systems Architect programme  ·  built by the Colaberry team
slides.caption: Course completion is not capability. A record saying someone watched a module answers a question nobody outside the classroom is asking.

slides.title: AI-assisted work makes this harder, not easier.
slides.subtitle: When a model can answer almost any exercise, the artefact alone stops being proof.
slides.caption: What is needed is evidence a sceptical reader can inspect: which competency, backed by which piece of work, recorded when, and still standing now.
The learner command centre. Solid on the skill wheel is what has been verified, not what has been attempted.
Six steps from a lesson to a portfolio, and it matters which of them are automatic and which are deliberately not.
The applied build a learner receives: what done means, which requirement it fulfils, and the repository that stays theirs.
A self-claim and a piece of applied work are not weighted the same, because a claim is not proof.
The build plan written into the learner's own repository, each sync carrying a correlation id.

slides.title: The evidence ledger has no update and no delete.
slides.subtitle: Not an oversight. The absence is the feature.
slides.caption: Every write is idempotency-keyed, and a record that can be revised after the fact is a claim rather than evidence.

slides.title: Competency is a recompute, not an increment.
slides.subtitle: Each domain is recalculated from all of a learner's evidence.
slides.caption: That makes the operation idempotent by construction: running it twice produces the same state, rather than counting the same work twice.

slides.title: Publishing is not automatic, and that is the point.
slides.subtitle: A human approval, and the learner's own choice of audience.
slides.caption: Two independent gates. Collapsing them into one would let approval imply consent, or consent imply approval.

slides.title: What is not finished is on the record too.
slides.subtitle: Placement readiness scoring and cohort-scale repository access are still in progress.
slides.caption: Updating a competency the instant a submission lands was considered and not pursued. The record says so rather than implying the loop is closed.
